These source examples are not an independent environmental endorsement.

source_refs.locator: Line 3 selection table: CC.2

CC.7.1: green-energy collective transport (1 point); CC.7.2: electric-vehicle charging points (4); CC.7.3: municipal pedestrianization, cycle lanes/parking, park-and-ride parking, high-occupancy vehicle encouragement or other measures in a sustainable-mobility plan (4). source_refs.locator: Line 3 selection table: CC.7

source_refs.locator: Line 3 selection table: IG.8
